Kindful, a popular donor management and fundraising platform, was acquired by Bloomerang in 2021. As a result, Kindful's features and functionalities have been integrated into Bloomerang's offerings. If you are looking for a direct replacement or an upgrade, Bloomerang would be the primary option to explore, as it now incorporates Kindful's capabilities alongside its own comprehensive donor management tools.

If you’re considering alternatives outside of this integration, you might also look into similar platforms such as DonorPerfect, NeonCRM, or Little Green Light, depending on your specific needs for donor management and fundraising.
